_comment: Illustrative newly-listed company with one reported year and losses. Kept as the worked example of what the model does when it cannot support a call: the cash base is negative, which is a blocking flag, so the decision comes back REVIEW rather than a confident SELL.
B12: Reusable launch cost advantage; Starlink subscriber network
B13: Only the current fiscal year is reported. Prior years are deliberately left blank, the model should refuse to rate this, not guess.
